summary.text: AD-REGNSKAP AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1985-03-15. Its registered activity: "Regnskapsførsel, økonomisk rådgivning og virksomhet som dertil står i forbindelse." Its main industry code is 69.202 (regnskapsføring og bokføring). It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 6 273 106 NOK and the annual result was 1 196 909 NOK; operating income was up from 5 742 842 NOK in 2024. Registered leadership: Arild Lars Holten Dyrnes (daglig leder and styrets leder), with 1 other board member. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (6367000LLZDBRIRFBB12). Recent changes in the register: latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-06-27.
